items.title: Nvidia Stock’s (NVDA) Sell-Off Looks Overdone Ahead of Q3
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) stock’s sell-off looks overdone to me, ahead of Q3 earnings. The artificial intelligence (AI) computing giant remains about 22% below its 52-week high after Friday’s premarket rebound. Yet CEO Jensen Huang reminded us just two weeks ago that “Demand is extraordinary. Capacity is the constraint.” That hardly describes a business losing any momentum. items.title: Analyzing AMD as a near-term beneficiary of Nvidia’s leadership uncertainty
items.summary: Investing.com -- The tape suggests investors are already treating Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) as a relative winner. It trades at $513.73 (+14.41%) as of Nov 9, 3:38 PM EST. NVIDIA (NVDA) is at $177.20 (-5.06%) at the same time. That’s a roughly 19-point gap in one session. AMD is also up about 134% YTD but down 15.6% over the past month, so it isn’t a clean one-way run.

items.title: Soprano to Support Organisations Navigating Microsoft Entra MFA Changes
items.summary: Australian automated communications technology company, Soprano Design, will support Microsoft Entra customers who need to continue using SMS and Voice multi-factor authentication (MFA) as Microsoft retires SMS and Voice authentication delivery in Microsoft Entra ID beginning 1 February 2027.
